notes.title: FREE! University Days - Bonus Pack 1 Available Now
notes.content:
Step beyond the boundaries of the main story in this exclusive DLC pack, featuring five high-resolution erotic encounters with some of the university's most provocative characters. These intimate side-stories deliver bold new fantasies, hidden desires, and uninhibited passion. Each scene offers unique dynamics, intense animation, and an unapologetically adult twist on student life.

[b]This DLC includes a pack of 6 Bonus scenes[/b]

🔥 Scene 1 – Doin’ It Better

When a curious student catches Miss Jones red-handed with a hidden toy after class, the tension erupts into a wild and explicit confrontation. With her husband watching from the shadows and control slipping from her fingers, Miss Jones submits to new authority—and discovers what real punishment feels like.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032572/ee300d8f309dac212f7cc913d1e10e196a3b7a67.png[/img]

🧛 Scene 2 – Bloodlust

A mysterious invite from Ivy leads to a dark, candlelit encounter like no other. After awakening to find himself already mid-thrust and turned into a vampire, the student is pulled into a supernatural spiral of blood, lust, and relentless energy. She's starving—for both blood and sex—and he’s about to be drained in every way possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032572/e31305b45cdb66b77eeea1908ba30285b3379480.png[/img]

🎆 Scene 3 – New Year’s Bang 
Outside a rooftop party, Taunt finds herself alone under the stars—until she’s joined by someone who knows exactly how to ring in the new year. Passion flares, clothes disappear, and as fireworks explode above, so does the chemistry between them in a New Year’s Eve celebration they’ll never forget.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032572/25c2f76305abdbeaf1303a5a18209dce3425024b.png[/img]

🏫 Scene 4 – Faculty Fantasy
Andrea can’t keep her hands—or her fantasies—to herself. Dragging her lover into a secluded room, she indulges her craving to be taken like a naughty teacher on the edge of getting caught. With risky roleplay, deep pounding, and a switch from backdoor surprise to explosive climax, this is faculty fun like never before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032572/8d484b5e4fe07c43d76395f9c313348ef6a593b0.png[/img]

💉 Scene 5 – Extra Credit
Rumors spread fast… especially about what certain teachers have heard. One particularly daring instructor invites the student over for a "private checkup," dressing to thrill in a nurse outfit and testing every inch of his stamina. No questions asked. No breaks given. Just raw, endless pleasure—strictly for her benefit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032572/b6b6b1e42b35a20da9b97918cacd07cb3c7eb6b2.png[/img]

🛒 Scene 6 – Behind the Counter
Alice’s toxic ex won’t leave her alone—until a friend steps in to help. After pretending to be a coworker to chase him off, tensions flip into desire. With emotions high and privacy low, the pair give in to temptation right there on the counter in a rebellious, heated release.
